h1.title: CREATIVITY
h1.body: We give ideas a creative direction. Concepts, art direction, design and storytelling turn a brand’s identity or a story into a distinctive experience shaped around its audience.

h2.title: CRAFT
h2.body: From characters and environments to interfaces and objects, we shape the visual language and every detail of the experience. Artists, designers and developers work together to bring the concept to life.

h3.title: TECHNOLOGY
h3.body: Creative coding, real-time 3D, AI, AR, VR and electronics are expressive tools. We choose them around the idea and the people, creating interactions between content, physical spaces and digital worlds.

h4.title: STRATEGY
h4.body: We start with what you want to communicate and the people you want to engage. We define the concept, audience journey and format: a brand experience, a cultural installation, a game or an adventure through a destination.

h5.title: INNOVATION
h5.body: Our in-house lab feeds our creative work. We experiment with expressive formats, technologies and materials, building prototypes to discover new possibilities for the experiences we imagine.

h6.title: DELIVERY
h6.body: We take projects from concept to production. We bring creative direction, design, development and integration together, working with project partners to put the experience in front of its audience.

projects.title: Projects
projects.playNote: Unity game in the browser, about 78 MB, keyboard and mouse
projects.gameLabel: Wii Tanks Remastered in the browser

esante.title: Healthcare coordination
esante.line: A platform where healthcare professionals message each other in real time, send care requests and sign prescriptions. I designed its message format, its guided tours and its end-to-end testing platform.

jobneko.title: JobNeko
jobneko.line: An open-source, self-hostable platform that reads job postings with LLMs: extraction from any website, a Chrome extension, salary analysis and RAG-based recommendations.

leonart.title: Leon'Art
leonart.line: A web and mobile art marketplace built by a team of seven, with Stripe payments and webhooks. Winner of the jury's Coup de cœur award at EPITECH Nancy's Moonshot.

wiitanks.title: Wii Tanks Remastered
wiitanks.line: A remake of the Wii Play tank game with reworked physics and AI-driven opponents. You can play it right here in the browser.

presence.title: Facial-recognition attendance
presence.line: An attendance app with a PyQt6 interface and a Python recognition engine built on PyTorch and OpenCV, running on-device or in the cloud with Firestore.

msc.title: MSC Découverte
msc.line: A site that helps EPITECH students choose their MSc specialty, with curated resources for each field.
